title: [solved] Suspend Broken with 7.1.2 up on Tuxedo InfinityBook 14 Pro
body: Hello, after updating to Linux 7.1.2, suspend no longer works on my laptop. When running `systemctl suspend` (or using the desktop suspend shortcut), the screen turns black, the fans continue spinning, and the system becomes completely unresponsive. It cannot be resumed and requires a hard power-off. System - Device: TUXEDO InfinityBook Pro 14 Gen10 - Working kernel: linux-lts, linux before 7.1.2 - Failing kernel: since linux 7.1.2-arch3-1 to current 7.1.3-arch1-1 - GPU: AMD Radeon 840M/860M (Krackan), amdgpu - Sleep mode: only s2idle is available (/sys/power/mem_sleep reports [s2idle]) The last kernel message before the system hangs is always: PM: suspend entry (s2idle) No further suspend-related messages are logged. Booting the `linux-lts` kernel on the same system with the same userspace, firmware and configuration restores normal suspend/resume functionality. Troubleshooting performed - Verified that linux-lts suspends and resumes correctly. - pm_test=freezer completes successfully. - pm_test=devices hangs in exactly the same way as a normal suspend. - Enabled pm_debug_messages, no_console_suspend, and initcall_debug; the last kernel message is still only: PM: suspend entry (s2idle) Log from booting and directly trying to suspend: journalctl -k -b
